 #TrafficUpdate

data.text:
[6:13AM] 
#Alausa
#Ikeja
#TrafficUpdate

The stretch of Wemco road and Lateef Jankande road is still good except for the traffic lights delay along the corridor but expected to be busy as the influx increases.

Obafemi Awolowo way inward Radio junction, Allen junction en route Ikeja underneath the bridge is also fair for now, likewise the return journey.

Inward and outward of Aromire, Kudirat Abiola way, Allen and Mobolaji Johnson avenue are also good.

We are also still experiencing smooth traffic flow along Dr Nurudeen Olowopopo stretch.
#FollowLASTMA

data.text:
[6:30AM]  #Apongbon
#EbuteEro
#TrafficUpdate

Steady movement on Eko bridge by NEPA inward Apongbon.
Descending Eko bridge inward  CMS bridge to connect CMS proper is good.

Descending Eko bridge inward Elegbata Mini stadium, Ebute Ero market are in good shape for now.

Descending from Carter bridge inward Ebute Ero market, Leventis through UBA roundabout to connect inner and outer Marina is also good to go.
Ebute Ero to  link Eko bridge is good to go,

Good  movement on Broad street to Apongbon underneath the bridge, Offin Canal market and Olowogbowo.

Good movement on CMS bridge inward Offin Canal market en route  Ijora Olopa by NEPA intersection.
